secondaries.note: Par2 time-window parameters fixed a priori (reduce.U_time = exp(sigma^2 / 6), reduce.par2_exit_x = the outlet plane L / W in box units, regular snapshots every plan par2.snapshots_every steps, about 100 per realization): sf43plan/design.py

gate4_power.source: SF-42 R3 displacement-basis pilot means (docs/experiments/2026-10-30-sf42-confirmatory-tooling.md, section 'Estimator noise by basis (R3, no new runs)', table lines 1025-1032, column 'mean disp'); planning alternatives, not claims about alpha_T

expected.note: pre-registered expectation, compared with the observed rates in the report; the engine halts an arm only above halt_rate (a systematic-failure detector); particle-stagnation fractions are reported, never failures

positive_control.expectation: R = (mean over the window planes [25, 94] of the measured FLUX-weighted displacement-basis second moment X22(d)) / (the same mean of the first-order box prediction at sigma^2 = 0.04, W = 24 lambda, L = 104 lambda), with a 90 % seed-bootstrap interval.  EXPECTED: the interval inside [0.8, 1.25] (positive_control_ok); inconclusive if it straddles a bound; failed if entirely outside.  Rationale: the prediction is first order in sigma^2 and the O(sigma^2) nonlinear corrections are about 4 % at 0.04; the discretization (lambda/h = 10) and the Dirichlet inflow/outflow faces of medium (b), which the prediction neglects, are expected to move the window mean by a few per cent at most.  A value outside the bounds indicts the estimand pipeline or the runner, not the physics.  Descriptive; never a gate of the family.
